status: APPROVED by Madhav 19 Oct 2026 17:05 Toronto, with the definitions below recorded before any run; frozen: any later change is oc-v2
source: Madhav's Opening Decision Protocol V1 (19 Oct 2026), encoded exactly; thresholds are candidates to test, not beliefs

definitions.gap: open(09:15) / PDC - 1; buckets flat |g|<0.25%, small 0.25-0.75%, large >=0.75%
definitions.OR_k: high and low from 09:15 to 09:15+k minutes, k in {5, 15, 30}
definitions.breadth_B_t: share of the point-in-time liquidity top 50 (u_liq_in, as of the previous session) with 5-minute data that day whose last price at t is above their own 09:15 open
definitions.agreement_A_t: sign(Nifty 50 - its open) equals sign(Nifty Bank - its open) at t
definitions.rvol_t: stocks only: cumulative volume 09:15..t over the median of the same window in the previous 20 sessions
definitions.vwap_t: stocks only: session VWAP from 5-minute typical price x volume; the index has no volume, so no index VWAP in primary tests
definitions.accepted_rejected: diagnostic, recorded not tested in primary: at 09:30 accepted if price is beyond half the OR15 range in the gap's direction; rejected if the gap has filled (price back through PDC)

states.CONFIRMED_LONG: a 1-minute close (5-minute for stocks) above OR_k high at or after 09:15+k, with B >= 0.60 and A true at that bar; stocks also rvol >= 1.5 and price > VWAP
states.CONFIRMED_SHORT: mirror: close below OR_k low, B <= 0.40, A true; stocks rvol >= 1.5 and price < VWAP
states.REVERSAL_CANDIDATE: secondary only: |gap| >= 0.5%, then a close back through the 09:15 open against the gap after 09:30, with B crossing 0.5 in the reversal direction
states.WAIT: no confirmed state by 10:15 (E1, E2) or by 11:30 (E4); recorded as a decision with its counterfactual
states.NO_TRADE: the day ends without a confirmed state, or a stand-down rule applies; a valid outcome

entries.E1_break: next bar open after the first qualifying break
entries.E2_retest: after the break, price returns within 0.10% (index) / 0.20% (stocks) of the broken OR edge within 30 minutes and the next bar closes away from it; enter at the following open; no retest = no trade (counted)
entries.E3_after_30: same as E1 with k = 30 (decision not before 09:45)
entries.E4_late: first qualifying break of OR30 between 10:15 and 11:30
entries.E5_no_trade_on_conflict: not a trade: the days the filters reject; their unfiltered outcome is the counterfactual that shows whether waiting saved money

exits.X1_invalidation: stop at the opposite edge of OR_k (E2: the retest extreme); else flat at 15:15
exits.X2_measured_room: X1: the setup invalidation level (the opposite OR edge; E2: the retest extreme) is the hard stop and a trade is never held past it. X2: a stop at m x OR width, m = 80th percentile of the adverse excursion of dev-period winners of the same variant, used as one input only: capped at the invalidation distance, floored at the instrument minimum (2 ticks and half the instrument's 5-minute ATR14 at entry). Both: time exit 15:15

instruments.NIFTY: Nifty 50 spot minutes traded as an index-future proxy (futures costs, 1-tick slippage, basis ignored, labelled)
instruments.BANKNIFTY: Nifty Bank spot minutes, same proxy
instruments.STOCKS: point-in-time liquidity top 100 with 5-minute data (survivorship-labelled), intraday long and short

primary_tests.event_day_test: on scheduled event days in the event registry (RBI 10:00, Budget 11:00, election counting), standing down until 30 minutes after the event beats trading through it: NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, k30|E1|X1
primary_tests.each_against_baseline: every primary variant is paired with the same entries and exits without the breadth, agreement, volume and VWAP filters (the unfiltered baseline); two questions: does it make money net of costs, and does confirmation improve on the baseline

secondary_grid.rule: exploratory: every variant counts in the ledger; a secondary result is reported only if it survives BH across the whole ledger and the family shuffle

options_mapping.historical: synthetic ATM option on the nearest weekly expiry priced with Black-76 from the index minute path and the previous session's IV (labelled SYNTHETIC)
options_mapping.suitability_check: before an option entry: required underlying move = (premium + 2 x half-spread + costs) / |delta| + theta x expected hold; take the option only if the playbook's dev-period favourable-excursion distribution reaches that move at least 60% of the time, else use the future or skip
options_mapping.forward: real recorder minutes and measured order-book spreads from 19 Oct 2026

statistics: one trade per index per day: t across days; stocks: per-day mean then t across days; registry family OC with its multiple-testing bar; robustness: at least 5 of 8 walk-forward folds with the same sign, liquidity halves, costs doubled, within-day shuffle for stock filters
data_limits: index minutes have no volume: volume and VWAP confirmation are tested on stocks only
breadth uses the covered constituents (75-93% of the liquidity top 50 by year)
stock 5-minute data covers 49-83% of the point-in-time top 250 by year (Kite lists only current instruments): stock results carry a survivorship label and a daily-bar bias check
no GIFT Nifty history: the overnight view uses the US close, USD/INR, Brent and the previous day's flows
no historical intraday options, futures, currency or commodity data before the recorder: those are synthetic, proxied or forward-only

approval_conditions.eligible_universe: stocks: the point-in-time liquidity top 100 (gold/universe u_liq_in rank <= 100 as of the previous session) with 5-minute bars that day; excluded: ETFs and fund units, names with an ambiguous corporate action or a frozen-price run in gold/ca_flags within 5 sessions, names in a circuit halt at the decision bar. Breadth uses the same rule with rank <= 50.
approval_conditions.breadth: fixed at 0.60 (bullish) / 0.40 (bearish) for the initial test: share of eligible top-50 names whose last price at the decision bar is above (below) their own 09:15 open
approval_conditions.directional_agreement: index: Nifty 50 and Nifty Bank both moved the same way since 09:15 at the decision bar, each by at least 0.05% (a move inside +/-0.05% counts as no direction, so no agreement); stocks: the stock and the Nifty 50 moved the same way since 09:15, same 0.05% rule
approval_conditions.relative_volume: fixed at 1.5: cumulative volume 09:15 to the end of the decision bar, divided by the median of the cumulative volume over the same clock window (09:15 to the same bar) in the previous 20 regular sessions; special and shortened sessions are left out of the baseline; at least 15 of the 20 sessions must have data, else the stock is not eligible that day
approval_conditions.time_of_day_baseline: every volume and range comparison is made against the same minutes of the day in earlier sessions, never against a full-day average
approval_conditions.decision_deadline: 10:15 IST for every primary entry (E1, E2, E3); no confirmed state by 10:15 = WAIT, and a WAIT day ends as NO TRADE; both are valid recorded decisions with their counterfactual. E4 (10:15-11:30) moves to the exploratory grid
approval_conditions.stops: X1: the setup invalidation level (the opposite OR edge; E2: the retest extreme) is the hard stop and a trade is never held past it. X2: a stop at m x OR width, m = 80th percentile of the adverse excursion of dev-period winners of the same variant, used as one input only: capped at the invalidation distance, floored at the instrument minimum (2 ticks and half the instrument's 5-minute ATR14 at entry). Both: time exit 15:15
approval_conditions.max_rupee_risk: position size = floor(max risk / (stop distance per unit + per-unit costs)); index proxy trades whole lots (lot size on that date from the F&O files); if one lot or one share would risk more than the maximum, the decision is NO TRADE with reason risk_cap. Maximum risk per trade: Rs 1,000 (2% of the Rs 50,000 paper book), set in paper_config.json; changing it is a config change, recorded with its sha
approval_conditions.event_verification: two independent credible sources or one official source; reactions only from the lake's price data; one-source events kept as leads, excluded from verified studies
approval_conditions.exploration_policy: the research phase stays open-eyed: exploratory cuts (other thresholds, regimes, instruments, the E4 window, reversals) are run and reported, clearly labelled EXPLORATORY and counted in the ledger when they claim anything; a promising one becomes a new pre-registered primary before it can reach a paper evidence book
